scope: All 142 released image-bearing OmniMatBench CAL tasks at pinned revision f933f03c733bb378ce5dd85b96452d9d5683c17e
verifier: Pinned upstream eval_cal_results.py score_exact through omnimatbench/verify.py
independence: Perturbation validity follows exact Decimal equality/inequality and answer-list structural invariants, independently of any solver outputs.
false_negative_denominator: Exact official references plus each distinct exact-Decimal-equivalent representation constructible by converting a parseable reference slot to fixed decimal notation while leaving all other slots unchanged.
false_positive_denominator: For every task: missing final slot, extra definitely-wrong slot, definitely-wrong first slot; plus every parseable numeric slot changed by abs(value)+1.
decision: FP and FN point rates are reported separately and must each be strictly below 15%. Wilson 95% intervals are disclosed but are not solver accuracy intervals.
exclusions: No rates inferred from model accuracy. No semantic paraphrases whose equivalence requires subjective materials-science judgment.
